The Extension Pack side was changed by commit 325987bdfa8e8191fcb4de32d57d3cd7152a5c19 away from string, though the current external source uses date rather than Jira's dateTime wording. No prior combined-branch commit had an Issue-Reconcile-Key trailer for FHIR-44722.
additional_context: FHIR-37959 later removed the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable profiles from core for R6 and directed ongoing maintenance outside the core FHIR specification. The current combined branch lacks source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-publishablevalueset.xml and has no active publishablevalueset profile entry in source/fhir.ini. TI Confluence minutes for 2024-08-05 record that FHIR-44722 was applied after permission to update the obviously wrong datatype.
